summary: TD Bank filed a Form 6-K attaching legal opinions from Simpson Thacher and McCarthy Tétrault relating to a shelf takedown of $2.8B in senior medium-term notes ($1.25B 4.361% due 2029, $300M floating rate due 2029, $1.25B 4.866% due 2033). This is a routine debt issuance under an existing F-3 shelf registration — not a special situation.
